name: audit_ledger
description: Every clause of the 13 November 2026 audit, with a state and something behind it. A DONE row names the files it changed; a REJECTED row carries the proof the finding was wrong. tools/validate/check_audit_ledger.py fails the build if a row loses its state, its evidence, or the ledger loses a row. Read this before claiming an audit was answered.

audit.source: The Drowned Greenwood: Full Audit and Re-Audit Report
audit.note: Section 2 is a summary of sections 4 and 5, section 9 is a suggested order, section 10 is a list of things the auditor could not verify. All three are transcribed so that no clause of the report is unaccounted for.

clauses.clause: Manifest build: 1,954 assets, no duplicates
clauses.evidence: build_manifest.py runs in CI on every change and the manifest job passes; the site is unchanged at 1,954 records.

clauses.clause: check_scripts: 18 Python, 1 shell, 8 JSON, 4 shader, 3 workflow YAML, 47 run blocks, 23 pinned actions
clauses.evidence: The static job passes. The counts have moved with the repo (now 21 Python, 1 shell, 7 JSON, 4 shader, 3 workflows); the claim was accurate for the snapshot audited.

clauses.clause: check_manifest: budgets 790 of 800 MB, 364 licence-review warnings, 1,110 custom assets
clauses.evidence: The manifest job passes and prints the budget headroom and the planned-licence warnings. The 1,110 custom records are now UNVERIFIED rather than project-original.

clauses.clause: check_skeletons: 56 bones, 104 of 104 species, 0 sources verified, hierarchy NOT validated
clauses.evidence: The CI log prints exactly those lines, including 'bone hierarchy NOT validated'.

clauses.clause: test_tools: 29 of 29 pass
clauses.evidence: Accurate for the round-3 snapshot, stale now: the suite holds 37 tests. README said 35, which check_docs.py caught on its first run; it says 37 now.

clauses.clause: Risk group: a verification step that verifies nothing
clauses.evidence: Carried by H1, which is DONE.

clauses.clause: Risk group: one unverifiable action pin
clauses.evidence: Carried by H2: the pin exists, and it is now resolved through the API on every run.

clauses.clause: Risk group: a footgun (commit_report overwriting the written analysis)
clauses.evidence: Carried by H3, which is DONE.

clauses.clause: Risk group: a broken data contract (hydrology channels)
clauses.evidence: Carried by H4, which is DONE.

clauses.clause: Risk group: a gap between built and exists
clauses.evidence: Carried by H5, partly done: the artifact exists, the manifest write-back waits on staging.

clauses.clause: Wind samplers had no repeat_enable
clauses.evidence: Both samplers declare repeat_enable and filter_linear_mipmap; test_tools asserts it and check_scripts now fails any sampler without it.

clauses.clause: The unauthored-mesh test used vertex colour (1,1,1) as the wind flag
clauses.evidence: The flag is the ALPHA channel, documented in wind_offset and in the include header.

clauses.clause: wetness_darken was a global uniform but documented per material
clauses.evidence: It is a plain uniform; the include explains why a global would force one value on the whole scene.

clauses.clause: Shared ci-serial group let a queued run be dropped
clauses.evidence: CONCURRENCY_POLICY is per workflow, fails on a missing policy, a shared group or a cancel-in-progress mismatch.

clauses.clause: The report job lost its explanation on failure and had no timeout
clauses.evidence: Summary and upload steps run with if: always(), and the report job has a timeout.

clauses.clause: Path filters missed tools/phase0, workflows and shaders
clauses.evidence: validate watches assets, shaders, tools and workflows; the Phase 0 workflow watches tools/phase0, shaders and TOOLS.md.

clauses.clause: The purge apply path would fail: set-url after filter-repo removed origin
clauses.evidence: It adds origin when it is gone, and refuses cleanly when a workflow-scope token is needed.

clauses.clause: The retarget map was written from convention and never diffed
clauses.evidence: The probe dumps the pack's real skin joint names and diffs them against the map as a required probe.

clauses.clause: Verified pins were not verified
clauses.evidence: Blender archives are hash-checked on every job cache hit or miss; Godot, gltfpack and Quaternius are pinned; MPFB2 is commit-pinned; actions are SHA-pinned and API-resolved.

clauses.clause: Variant-name collisions were undetected
clauses.evidence: A collision is reported and a test covers it.

clauses.clause: Silent defaults: tier A, phase 0, blanket CC0
clauses.evidence: A missing phase or tier is an error and the licence is derived from the tool; unknown yields None and fails.

clauses.clause: Built needed only a path and hash
clauses.evidence: Built now requires path, sha256, input_hash, tool_version and gate_results.

clauses.clause: The report parser passed unknown key=value lines and dropped malformed JSON
clauses.evidence: A missing verdict, malformed JSON and a crash after a result all fail, and each has a test.

clauses.clause: Coverage matching used substrings (bow matches elbow)
clauses.evidence: Matching is on clip-name tokens.

clauses.clause: No size guard and .gitignore gaps
clauses.evidence: check_repo_hygiene enforces 20 MB and refuses .blend/.hdr/.exr; the ignore rules are anchored.

clauses.clause: run: blocks were never syntax-checked
clauses.evidence: Every run block goes through bash -n, and the checker fails if none ran.

clauses.clause: The Blender export could drop the vertex colours carrying the wind data
clauses.evidence: export_glb asks for export_vertex_color=ACTIVE with a fallback for older exporters.

clauses.clause: Cape plus tabard chains would exceed 65 bones
clauses.evidence: The cloth budget is computed from the bone list: 56 + 6 = 62, a second chain would need 68.

clauses.clause: Retarget map verification: the probe exists but reports 0 sources verified
clauses.evidence: Phase 0 ran on c179cac: retarget_bones PASS with joints_in_glb=65, mapped_names=23, matched=23, unmatched_map_entries=[]. check_skeletons still prints 0 sources verified because the status stays pending_verification until a clip is retargeted, which is a different claim and is Phase 5.

clauses.clause: Animal skeleton hierarchies and rest poses are not validated
clauses.unblock: Phase 4, when there are animal rigs to validate against rather than invented data.

clauses.clause: Mobile renderer verification is not proven in CI
clauses.unblock: A real-device check on an Android phone; the CI gate compiles under Compatibility by design.

clauses.clause: 1,110 custom assets with no generator
clauses.unblock: Each record needs either a generator or a recorded source; until then they are UNVERIFIED and cannot be built.

clauses.clause: H1: the purge credential scan checked a path that does not exist
clauses.evidence: It scans purge-work/config and purge-backup/config, refuses when the file is missing, refuses on grep exit 2, and reads the real archive member purge-backup/config.

clauses.clause: H2: one pinned action SHA could not be confirmed
clauses.evidence: The GitHub API returns 11d5960a… as a real PGP-verified commit (backport fixes to releases-v4, July 2026); the auditor's 11bd719… is the older v4.2.2.

sub.clause: Resolve every pin in CI
sub.evidence: A 404 fails, a rate limit warns, a run that resolved nothing fails; it passed on 69e7851.

sub.clause: Dependabot manages the pins
sub.why: It opens PRs on a repository with no review flow; the API check now catches the failure that mattered.

clauses.clause: H3: commit_report would overwrite the hand-written analysis
clauses.evidence: make_report writes reports/tool_evaluation.generated.md, the upload and commit steps use that name, and the written report is untouched.

clauses.clause: H4: the hydrology mask channel contract was wrong
clauses.evidence: The mask is RGB8 with depth in R and a unit vector in G,B, and CI asserts colour type 2 rather than assuming it.

sub.clause: Sample the direction with filter_nearest
sub.evidence: The direction is a unit vector in two channels precisely so that bilinear filtering between neighbours is meaningful; nearest sampling would throw that away and produce a stepped current.

sub.clause: Round-trip the mask in Godot rather than only inspecting the PNG
sub.evidence: The Phase 0 Godot job generates the mask in the same run, loads it in the engine and fails on a wrong format or a direction channel that does not decode to a unit vector — which is the LA8 failure a header check cannot see. Written, not yet run.

clauses.clause: H5: the Phase 2 assets are reported as built but exist nowhere
clauses.evidence: The maps are uploaded as the terrain-maps artifact, phase2.md says built means generated and measured in CI, and the mechanism to commit them now exists: assets/built.json holds the evidence, tools/record_built.py writes it only for files whose hash matches the generator's report, build_manifest.py merges it, and a publish job commits the maps plus that evidence to staging on a manual dispatch.

sub.clause: Write path, sha256 and gate results back into the manifest records
sub.why: The mechanism is in place and no record is built yet: the publish job has not been dispatched, because a binary entering history is a decision and the bytes can only be produced in CI.

sub.clause: Run the publish job once
sub.why: It needs an owner dispatch (Actions, validate, Run workflow, publish_terrain). Until then the built path is unexercised.

clauses.clause: M1: terrain map size contradicted itself (1024 vs 1025)
clauses.evidence: Every document says 1025²; ADDITIONS.md was the last file still saying 1024², and check_docs fails if it returns.

clauses.clause: M2: the foliage shader may not cut out the way its comment says
clauses.evidence: Godot's material docs: alpha scissor draws surviving fragments opaque, does not exhibit sorting issues and can cast shadows — which is what the comment claimed. The suggested ALPHA = 1.0 would have made the scissor discard nothing.

sub.clause: The real bug this turned up: surface_base wrote ALPHA = 1.0, forcing the transparent pipeline
sub.evidence: The write is gone; a test asserts an opaque shader never writes ALPHA and a cut-out shader writes a texture channel.

sub.clause: Leaf cards thin with distance because a box-filtered mip averages alpha away
sub.evidence: Recorded as a texture-import decision in materials.json: mipmaps must be generated, the alpha dilated before they are, and alpha_cutoff is what holds a distant card together until a coverage-preserving chain is authored.

sub.clause: Verify the blend and scissor behaviour on a device
sub.why: It needs the Mobile renderer on real hardware.

clauses.clause: M3: the shader gate proves parsing, not runtime behaviour or the target renderer
clauses.evidence: Checkable mistakes are now gated: every sampler must declare repeat_enable, and a Python test mirrors the wind UV maths. The renderer gap is documented rather than implied to be covered.

sub.clause: Prove Mobile-renderer behaviour
sub.unblock: A real-device smoke checklist; headless Godot compiles under Compatibility and cannot answer it.

clauses.clause: M4: make_report still treats stale items as expected gaps
clauses.evidence: EXPECTED_GAPS is empty with the reasoning recorded, the duplicate mpfb_import key is gone and the render labels agree.

sub.clause: A checksum_mismatch classified as a defect
sub.evidence: The mechanism is kept but the set is empty, so a mismatch reads as a defect.

clauses.clause: M5: purge workflow loose ends
clauses.evidence: All four are closed.

sub.clause: Count queued runs, not only in_progress
sub.evidence: The jq filter selects status in_progress or queued.

sub.clause: Use HISTORY_PURGE_TOKEN automatically instead of requiring a hand edit
sub.evidence: The push step prefers the secret when present and says which token it used.

sub.clause: The environment self-review claim may be wrong
sub.evidence: Prevent self-review is an option, off unless ticked; the comment and the docs now say so, citing GitHub's page.

sub.clause: Path validation must reject a leading '-' and a bare '.'
sub.evidence: Both are rejected with a message that says why.

clauses.clause: M6: licence provenance moved rather than disappeared
clauses.evidence: custom maps to UNVERIFIED: planned but never buildable, warned on every run. Fonts, audio and music need a recorded source before they can ship.

sub.clause: Record per-asset licences for MPFB2 community assets
sub.why: Their licences vary per asset and none is built yet; the record belongs with the first asset that uses one.

clauses.clause: M7: generators are stdlib-only and will hit the job limit
clauses.unblock: A pinned numpy, or a split generator job, when a run approaches the 10-minute ceiling; recorded in POLICY.md with that trigger.

clauses.clause: M8: documentation and contract mismatches
clauses.evidence: Three of the four are closed.

sub.clause: surface_ids.json names check_surfaces.py, which does not exist
The zip contains tools/generators/__pycache__/*.pyc
sub.evidence: Nothing under __pycache__ is in the tree and .gitignore covers it.

sub.clause: anim_retarget_report Phase 1 scheduling versus its Phase 5 dependency
sub.evidence: The group note states it is issued twice and why it lives in the rig category.

sub.clause: Add an explicit dependency check to the manifest validator
sub.why: There is no depends_on data model to check. The one real ordering bug — the wind textures depending on Phase 9 — is fixed by placing 4.P.tex in Phase 2, with the reason in the group note.

clauses.clause: The skeleton bone_math prose double-counts toes
clauses.evidence: 7 spine/head + 2 eyes + jaw + 2 shoulders + 6 arm + 6 leg + 2 toes = 26, which is the real non-finger count. The prose is right and the implied 28 is not.

clauses.clause: The rest pose faces -Z while glTF's front is +Z
clauses.evidence: Already decided and documented in char_skeleton_definition.json: front is -Z here, the export rotates 180 degrees about Y, and an export that skips it walks backwards.

clauses.clause: Blender 4.2 LTS is past its support window
clauses.evidence: Recorded with its reason and trigger in TOOLS.md and POLICY.md: 4.2 is kept because MPFB2 requires it, and dropped the moment MPFB2 works on 4.5.

clauses.clause: Plan for Play Asset Delivery if published on Google Play
clauses.evidence: Recorded in POLICY.md as deferred, with 'not planned yet' as the trigger.

clauses.clause: Sparse checkout remains deferred
clauses.evidence: POLICY.md records it with the trigger: the first committed binary, at which point the layout is known.

clauses.clause: Texture compression for Android is not configured or gated
clauses.evidence: It was recorded nowhere. POLICY now has the row, the trigger (the first export preset) and the shape of the gate.

clauses.clause: The Phase 0 control rests on a single sphere with no UVs, normals, skinning or colours
clauses.evidence: The sphere now carries a wind_mask colour attribute at alpha 0, wired into the material so the exporter cannot omit it, and the Godot probe counts ARRAY_COLOR and fails without it. UVs and normals came with the UV sphere; skinning is covered by the MPFB2 human.

sub.clause: Run the changed probe in CI
sub.why: The Phase 0 run that contained it died on an unrelated YAML error before Blender started. It runs on the next tools/phase0 or shaders change, or a manual dispatch.

clauses.clause: Per-workflow concurrency replaces the one-run rule
clauses.evidence: Agreed: a shared group drops pending runs, which is worse than overlap. The purge's in-flight check is documented as narrowing rather than closing the window.

clauses.clause: Deferring sparse checkout and animal hierarchies is sound
clauses.evidence: Both are recorded with triggers in POLICY.md; the reasoning is that a validator with no data passes by finding nothing.

clauses.clause: Naming the weaker checks is the right habit
clauses.evidence: The animal validator prints NOT validated, the report prints Compatibility rather than Mobile, and both do so on every run.

clauses.clause: [CI] Resolve every pinned SHA through the GitHub API
clauses.evidence: Runs in the static job; passed on 69e7851.

clauses.clause: [CI] Let Dependabot manage the pins
clauses.why: It opens PRs on a repository with no review flow, and the API check now catches the failure the suggestion was aimed at.

clauses.clause: [CI] Add actionlint and shellcheck
clauses.why: Both are new dependencies; check_scripts already runs bash -n on every run block and parses every workflow.

clauses.clause: [CI] Branch protection and a pull-request-only flow into main
clauses.why: A repository setting, not code, so it cannot be made from here. POLICY.md now records the exact ruleset to configure and why it is the substitute for a pre-push hook.

clauses.clause: [CI] A .githooks/pre-push hygiene check
clauses.why: There is no terminal on the device this project is worked from, so a local hook would never run. The ruleset in POLICY.md moves the same guard to before the merge instead of after the commit, and HISTORY_PURGE.md stays the recovery path.

clauses.clause: [CI] CODEOWNERS for workflows and tools/validate
clauses.why: A single maintainer: every path is already owned by the only contributor.

clauses.clause: [CI] Sparse checkout once the asset layout exists
clauses.unblock: The first committed binary reveals the layout; POLICY.md records it.

clauses.clause: [Validation] A manifest dependency check
clauses.why: No machine-readable dependency edges exist; the one real ordering bug is fixed by phase placement.

clauses.clause: [Validation] A built-record verifier that opens the file
clauses.evidence: Path, sha256, input_hash, tool_version and gate_results are required for a built record.

sub.clause: Open the file and compare its hash and format
sub.unblock: The first committed binary; POLICY.md records it.

clauses.clause: [Validation] A doc-consistency check
clauses.evidence: It guards the README's asset, material and test counts and the 1025 contract, and it failed on its first run for a real drift.

clauses.clause: [Validation] A sampler repeat lint
clauses.evidence: Every sampler must declare repeat_enable unless argued into CLAMPED_SAMPLERS; two tests cover it.

clauses.clause: [Validation] A CPU reference test for the wind maths
clauses.evidence: The wind UV test mirrors wind_phase and fails if the UV stops leaving the unit range without repeat.

clauses.clause: [Generators] Run each generator twice and compare hashes
clauses.evidence: CI runs all three and compares 13 produced files byte for byte.

sub.clause: Run that step green at least once
sub.why: It has not yet executed; the run that contained it failed on unrelated YAML.

clauses.clause: [Generators] Keep golden hashes for the terrain
clauses.why: They would have to be regenerated on every tuning change and would be rubber-stamped; the twice-run comparison proves determinism without that maintenance.

clauses.clause: [Generators] Terrain quality gates: walkable percentage, flat spawn areas, no isolated lakes
clauses.why: Only the river gates exist (descent, length, water present). Walkable percentage and connected-component analysis are not written.

clauses.clause: [Generators] A Godot-side round-trip probe for the hydrology encoding
clauses.evidence: The Phase 0 Godot job now generates the mask, copies it into the probe project and loads it, asserting FORMAT_RGB8, 1025², that water texels exist, and that every direction texel decodes to unit length. It is registered as a required probe, so a Phase 0 run cannot pass without it.

sub.clause: Run it at least once
sub.why: It needs a Phase 0 dispatch; written and reasoned, unexecuted.

clauses.clause: [Generators] Move heavy loops to numpy
clauses.unblock: A measured run approaching the job limit; recorded in POLICY.md.

clauses.clause: [Shaders] Triplanar mapping in surface_base for UV-less rocks
clauses.why: A real feature, not a fix: it adds a per-material branch to a shader chosen for Mobile compile cost. Phase 2 material work.

clauses.clause: [Shaders] A cap on the number of shader variants
clauses.why: Nothing measures variants yet; the one-shader decision is documented but uncounted.

clauses.clause: [Shaders] A wind-mask round-trip probe through Blender, gltfpack -noq and Godot
clauses.evidence: Phase 0 ran on 550d77c with the sphere carrying a wind_mask attribute. Result: vertex_colours=1223 arrive, wind_mask_vertices=0 — the RGB channels survive and the ALPHA does not, so the wind flag is lost between Blender and Godot. The probe did its job: it turned a silent 'every plant is rigid' into a measured failure.

sub.clause: Observe the gltfpack result
sub.evidence: The same run measured the -noq output at vertex_colours=0: gltfpack drops the attribute entirely, so foliage LODs cannot carry a wind mask as the pipeline stands.

sub.clause: Make the alpha survive Blender's glTF export
sub.why: Needs a Blender run to test: either the exporter writes COLOR_0 as VEC3 when the alpha is unused by the material, or Godot's importer defaults it. The probe now distinguishes the two cases and prints both counts.

sub.clause: Stop making vertex colours a requirement for every loaded file
sub.evidence: The check became unconditional and turned the tree, the human and the gltfpack load red on the first run that exercised it. The workflow now passes expect_vertex_colours=1 for the sphere only, which is where the mask is authored; the gltfpack runs deliberately do not, because that run is measuring what gltfpack does to the attribute, not asserting it keeps it.

sub.clause: Fix gltfpack dropping COLOR_0
sub.why: Measured on 550d77c: the -noq output loads with vertex_colours=0, so the attribute is gone. Foliage LODs therefore cannot carry a wind mask through gltfpack as the pipeline stands. The fix is a keep-attributes flag or an authored mask channel that survives, and it needs a run to test the flag exists in v1.3.

clauses.clause: [Shaders] Add wetness_darken to the shader probe's expected uniforms
clauses.evidence: It is in EXPECTED_UNIFORMS for the wetness include, and the Godot job passed with it.

clauses.clause: [Licensing] Use UNVERIFIED for custom until inputs are recorded
clauses.evidence: Done, with the build refusing to ship one.

clauses.clause: [Licensing] Require per-asset licence and attribution for audio, fonts and music
clauses.evidence: They are UNVERIFIED until a source is recorded, which is the structural half; a CC-BY attribution entry in LICENSES.md is still written by hand when the first one arrives.

sub.clause: Machine-check CC-BY attribution in LICENSES.md
sub.why: No CC-BY asset exists yet; the check would guard nothing today.

clauses.clause: [Licensing] Review MPFB2 and Modular Tree outputs
clauses.evidence: MTree carries NEEDS-REVIEW and cannot be built; MPFB2 is CC0 per its LICENSE.ASSETS.md.

clauses.clause: [Documentation] Generate README and ADDITIONS counts from the manifest
clauses.evidence: Generating the prose would be fragile; check_docs derives the counts and fails when the README disagrees. ADDITIONS deliberately states no counts and says so.

clauses.clause: [Documentation] One pin table in TOOLS.md, separate hand-written and generated reports
clauses.evidence: TOOLS.md says it is the only pin table, and the generated report is a different file.

clauses.clause: Fix order step 1: verify the checkout SHA
clauses.evidence: Verified real, then made checkable on every run.

clauses.clause: Fix order step 2: the credential scan paths
Fix order step 3: the generated report before anyone sets commit_report
Fix order step 4: the hydrology channel layout and the map size
clauses.evidence: H4 and M1.

clauses.clause: Fix order step 5: persist the built assets and update the manifest
clauses.unblock: The staging branch; the artifact half is done, the manifest write-back is not.

clauses.clause: Fix order step 6: report classification, purge loose ends, doc fixes
clauses.evidence: M4, M5 and M8.

clauses.clause: Fix order step 7: shader behaviour on device and the wind-maths lint
clauses.evidence: The lint and the reference test exist; the device half is deferred.

clauses.clause: Fix order step 8: licence provenance and generator performance
clauses.evidence: M6 done; M7 deferred with a trigger.

clauses.clause: Confirm actions/checkout SHA 11d5960a… exists
clauses.evidence: It exists: a real PGP-verified commit returned by the API. No confirmation is needed because the premise (that it might not) is wrong.

clauses.clause: Confirm Terrain3D region sizes versus 1025 squared
clauses.why: Terrain3D is not used: LICENSES.md records it as listed but not used, and the terrain is generated by our own scripts.

clauses.clause: Confirm Godot loads LA8 PNG as grey plus alpha
clauses.evidence: The question is moot: the mask is RGB8, so there is no grey-plus-alpha ambiguity to confirm.

clauses.clause: Confirm the foliage blend and scissor behaviour
clauses.evidence: Godot's material documentation states alpha scissor draws surviving fragments opaque and can cast shadows. Device confirmation remains outstanding.

sub.clause: Confirm on a device
sub.why: Needs the Mobile renderer on real hardware.

clauses.clause: Confirm headless means parse-only shader checks
clauses.evidence: The workflow says --headless uses a dummy renderer, and README states the gate compiles under Compatibility and that Mobile is part of the device check.

clauses.clause: Confirm the GitHub environment self-review default
clauses.evidence: Prevent self-review is an option that is off unless ticked; the docs now say what each setting means instead of asserting the outcome.

clauses.clause: Confirm gltfpack keeps COLOR_0 with -noq and no -kv
clauses.why: The probe now has colours to lose, but the control has not run since. This is the next Phase 0 run's job.

clauses.clause: Confirm the Blender 4.2 LTS support end date
clauses.unblock: A vendor announcement page read; the decision does not depend on the exact date because MPFB2 is the binding constraint.

clauses.clause: Confirm Node 20 action deprecation timing
clauses.evidence: CI now warns on every job: 'Node.js 20 is deprecated … being forced to run on Node.js 24'. Upgrading the action pins is not done and is not required by this audit.

clauses.clause: Confirm Quaternius rig bone naming
clauses.evidence: Measured: Unreal-mannequin naming, not Mixamo. The retarget map was rewritten against the real joints and the diff is a required probe.

clauses.clause: There is a cliff across the map: the height jumps 14-23 m between neighbouring samples at row 736
clauses.evidence: The river carve was ended by `if v < 0.72`, which left a wall across its whole width. The carve now runs its full length through a smoothstep taper and a rim notch. Measured after the fix: the largest step between neighbouring texels is under the 6 m gate, down from 23 m, and the gate reports the location of the worst one.

clauses.clause: Hard-edged circles: the rim and bog bowl are discs with abrupt edges, and the surface map paints a ring along them
clauses.evidence: The rim radius and the bog radius are both warped by the noise field and blended with smoothstep, so neither edge nor the gradient threshold they used to sit on is a circle.

clauses.clause: The river is a 200 m wide, 100 m deep trench with a dry floor
clauses.evidence: The channel is 8 m half-width blended toward a bed height, with the rim opening over 200 m where it leaves the valley. Water is 6.32 % of the map and the centreline is 321 points, all descending.

clauses.clause: The upper river water is buried: the surface sits 1.2 m below the bed for 226 of 655 points
clauses.evidence: A sign error: bed - depth instead of bed + depth. Fixed, and CI now fails if any river point has its water surface at or below the bed.

clauses.clause: The surface map and the splat maps disagree: the dominant splat matches on only 46 % of land cells
clauses.evidence: Two classifications of one cell. terrain_surfaces now reads the surface-ID map and puts 85 % of each cell's weight on that cell's layer. Measured: 100.0 % agreement over 984,212 land cells, gated at 95 %.

clauses.clause: Water is counted two ways: 5.80 % in the hydrology mask against 4.53 % in the surface map
clauses.evidence: Hydrology counted every high-flow cell as water as well as ground below the waterline. Both now use the one rule, and the last run reports 6.32 % from both generators.

clauses.clause: The terrain is very steep: mean slope 16 degrees and 10.7 % of cells above 30
clauses.evidence: Much of it was the trench and the rings, and the rest was the rim sitting on the threshold. The rim is restored to 0.40 / 2.4 rather than flattened, and the gate measures 80 % of land and 92 % of the inner valley under 30 degrees. Flattening the world to pass a single map-wide number was the wrong fix and was reverted.

clauses.clause: The generator header says 0..600 m but the code uses 200 m
clauses.evidence: The docstring says 0..200 m, which is what MAX_HEIGHT_M has always been.

clauses.clause: The west and east edge columns are identical because the noise wraps east-west only
clauses.evidence: The noise wraps in both axes, not only east-west: the lattice is sampled with wraparound and the upsample maps 0..1 across the full window, so both opposite edges coincide. That makes the map a tile of a larger world, which is what it is; breaking the wrap would put a visible seam where two tiles meet. Recorded rather than changed.

clauses.clause: The macro-noise texture is 1025 px with identical edges, so it duplicates a texel when tiled
clauses.evidence: It is 1024² now, and the gate asserts that size.

clauses.clause: Splat weights sum to 253-258, not 255
clauses.evidence: Each channel was rounded independently. The residual now goes on the dominant channel, so every texel sums to exactly 255.

clauses.clause: The flow-direction axis convention is not documented
clauses.evidence: The header states it: G is the east component, B is the south component (increasing row index), and a neutral texel is (128,128).

clauses.clause: Self-sweep, character rig: the retarget map's source names are verified only when Phase 0 runs, so a hand-edited key that stops naming a real joint goes unnoticed in between
clauses.evidence: check_skeletons now cross-checks every map key against the evidence block's full_joint_list — the same joint list the map was rewritten from — so a typo fails in the manifest job, not at the next Phase 0 run.

clauses.clause: Self-sweep, character rig: 65 recorded joints, 23 mapped, the other 42 unaccounted for
clauses.evidence: Every unmapped joint must match the documented finger-chain pattern (thumb_01_l … pinky_04_leaf_r) or the *_leaf helper pattern, or the check names it as silently dropped. Measured against the recorded list: 23 mapped + 40 finger + 2 ball_leaf helpers = 65.

clauses.clause: Self-sweep, character rig: no check that Right mirrors Left about x=0
clauses.evidence: check_mirror_symmetry walks all 28 Left/Right pairs and compares head and tail: x negates, y and z equal. All pairs pass; the check exists so a one-sided edit fails in CI rather than reading as a limp in-game.

clauses.clause: Self-sweep, character rig: profile membership was checked one way only — every bone being a profile name does not prove every profile name is present
clauses.evidence: The reverse direction is now asserted: all 56 SkeletonProfileHumanoid names must appear in the definition, so dropping one (UpperChest, say) fails instead of shrinking the rig silently.

clauses.clause: Self-sweep, character rig: the retarget map's rest_pose claim (pack rests in T-pose) was asserted from the vendor's previews, never measured from the file
clauses.evidence: The retarget_bones probe now composes the GLB's rest transforms from the node hierarchy and reports arm_elevation_deg — the upper-arm to lower-arm vector's elevation, ~0 degrees in T-pose and ~45 in A-pose. The map's rest_pose text says the claim is an assumption until that figure exists in a Phase 0 report. The measurement itself is unverified until then: it is new code that has not run.
